detail.description: What is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it.

severity_label.description: The severity label in the perspective's own scale, copied verbatim (e.g. Critical, Important, HIGH, Critical Gap (8)); for a perspective without a scale, the priority with 1 as the highest.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding is about.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the new version of the file, or null when the finding is not tied to one line.

confidence.description: Confidence that the finding is valid, from 0 to 1.
